children: SpaceX (SPCX, Financials), is drawing fresh attention from Wall Street as Morgan Stanley highlights its growing technology links with Tesla and Elon Musk's expanding artificial intelligence ambitions.

Morgan Stanley said the two companies share technology, talent and infrastructure, with SpaceX contributing areas such as computing and connectivity while Tesla brings capabilities in robotics, energy and manufacturing. The firm described the relationship as a developing Physical AI ecosystem.
SpaceX shares climbed about 1% overnight after falling nearly 1% Monday. Tesla shares also gained about 3% Tuesday.

Separately, Grok 4.7 launched Sept. 21, roughly three weeks after Musk's original Sept. 1 target. Deepwater Asset Management's Gene Munster said the timing was close enough to view the release as effectively on schedule.

The launch is also drawing attention to Grok 5, which Musk has targeted for late 2026. Musk has said the next model could incorporate data from SpaceX, potentially giving xAI access to a large engineering and operational dataset.
For SpaceX, the bigger story is increasingly about how its satellite network, computing infrastructure and relationships with Tesla and xAI could fit into a broader AI ecosystem.
The next catalyst is whether SpaceX announces additional AI infrastructure or commercial partnerships tied to its expanding computing business.

title: SpaceX Just Got a Major AI Vote of Confidence From Wall Street
